bug.actual_behavior: The official Pandoc Windows zip extracts pandoc.exe at the package root, but the wrapper checks a bin/pandoc path and exits with pandoc binary not found after installation.
evidence: Downloaded archive contains pandoc.exe at the extracted package root while the wrapper constructs a bin/pandoc path.
bug.expected_behavior: The wrapper should locate pandoc.exe from the official Windows zip and render the Rmd after auto-installation.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Run knit_rmd_html.py on Windows without pandoc in PATH and allow the default Pandoc 3.8.3 auto-install.
Observe that the archive is extracted but the wrapper exits before rendering because it looks for bin/pandoc.
bug.summary: Windows Pandoc auto-install assumes a nonexistent bin subdirectory
bug.workaround: Add the extracted package root containing pandoc.exe to PATH and rerun the wrapper with --no-install.
